comments.body_html: For anyone wanting to use this on 3.10 or any other version that it isn’t updated for since the code isn’t anything specific for any versions, all you need to do is go into the “package.json” file, and change the SPT version to whatever you are playing on (if you were trying to use it on 3.10, you would change it from from ~3.9.0 to ~3.10.0).
